postularse.intro: These properties are within what the insurers approved for you, so you can take them. Applying is the first step of a process, not the end.

postulas.texto: You can apply to several properties at once with the same approval, without checking again or paying again.

comparan.texto: Applying does not reserve the property or hand it to you. The agency reviews your application alongside the others.

respuesta.texto: We'll tell you here and by email if you were chosen. If you weren't, we'll tell you too — you won't be left waiting.

firma.texto: If you're chosen, the contract is signed from here. You don't have to go to any office.

otro.texto: It's more common than it seems: many leases are signed by a family member. If someone close to you is approved, they're the holder and you live there.
